create.name: Sweetwater Zen Center
create.bio:
Sweetwater Zen Center is an urban Zen Buddhist temple in National City, on the southern edge of San Diego, founded in 1999 by Anne Seisen Saunders Roshi. It belongs to the Soto school and the White Plum Asanga and is affiliated with the Zen Peacemakers. Seisen trained under Taizan Maezumi Roshi, is a Dharma successor of Bernie Tetsugen Glassman, and before founding the centre spent fifteen years at the Los Angeles Zen Center and served as co-abbot of Zen Mountain Center in Idyllwild. Since February 2025 Bobby Chowa Werner Sensei has been abbot, with Seisen as abbot emeritus and several affiliate teachers alongside him.

Zazen and walking meditation are held on Tuesday to Saturday mornings and evenings, and Sundays bring a service, meditation, an introductory class for newcomers and a dharma talk; most sessions can also be joined on Zoom. The centre holds silent sesshin retreats with private meetings with a teacher, offers long and short stays for residents in cottages on its grounds, and runs a programme that brings meditation to people in prison and writes to them by post. Talks by the abbot and affiliate teachers go up on its YouTube channel most weeks.

courses.title: Sesshin (silent Zen retreats)
courses.description: Silent retreats at the centre with a full day of zazen, private meetings with a teacher, dharma talks, chanting and shared work and meals, in weekend and week-long forms; guests may stay overnight on site.

courses.title: Residency
courses.description: Long-term residence in one of the centre's two-bedroom cottages, with light practice commitments alongside work and family life, or a guest stay of up to three months for practitioners.
courses.price: $1600/mo for one person, $1650/mo for two people

free_resources.title: Intro to Zen Meditation Class
free_resources.description: A Sunday 10am class at the centre on how to sit, the forms of the meditation hall and bringing practice into daily life, with an instructional video on the same page; a small donation is asked but not required.

free_resources.title: Weekly meditation schedule (in person and on Zoom)
free_resources.description: Morning and evening zazen and walking meditation from Tuesday to Saturday and a Sunday programme with a dharma talk, open in person or on Zoom.

free_resources.title: Dharma talks and podcasts
free_resources.description: The centre's page pointing to its recorded talks on YouTube and as a podcast.
